description: The PATIENTS table contains demographic information for patients in the database. It includes a unique patient identifier (SUBJECT_ID), gender, date of birth (DOB), dates of death from various sources (DOD, DOD_HOSP, DOD_SSN), and an expiration flag indicating patient mortality.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each patient in the database.

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: The gender of the patient, either 'F' for female or 'M' for male.

columns.name: DOD_HOSP
columns.description: The date of death as recorded by the hospital.

columns.name: DOD_SSN
columns.description: The date of death as recorded by the Social Security Administration.

columns.name: EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A binary flag indicating whether the patient has expired (1) or is still alive (0).
